items.title: Moderna amends credit agreement to reduce interest rates and extend maturity.
items.summary: Moderna amended its credit agreement with Ares Capital Corporation on November 9, 2026, reducing interest rate margins by 0.75 percentage points and extending the maturity date of initial and delayed draw term loans by one year to November 24, 2031. The amendment also extends the availability period for $400 million of delayed draw commitments to November 24, 2029 and for the remaining $500 million to the same date.

items.title: Aon plc completes $17.0 billion acquisition of USI
items.summary: Aon plc completed its acquisition of USI on November 16, 2026, for a total purchase price of $17.0 billion paid in cash and restricted shares. USI, the tenth largest U.S. insurance broker with approximately $3 billion in annual revenue and more than 10,500 team members, will operate as "USI, an Aon company" under the leadership of Michael J. Sicard, who was appointed President of Aon and global CEO of middle market. Aon expects to achieve $395 million of net adjusted EBITDA synergies from the acquisition and will provide details on 2027 outlook in early 2027.

items.title: Cheniere Energy promotes Zach Davis to President and Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: Zach Davis, who has served as Chief Financial Officer since August 2020, was promoted to President and Chief Financial Officer of Cheniere Energy effective November 12, 2026. Davis, 42, joined Cheniere in November 2013 and has over 20 years of experience in energy and infrastructure finance. Jack Fusco continues as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

items.title: Diamondback Energy agrees to acquire Double Eagle subsidiaries for $2.15 billion and stock
items.summary: Diamondback Energy has agreed to acquire Spanish Peak Energy and Lone Peak Energy from Double Eagle for approximately $2.15 billion in cash and 15.56 million shares of common stock, subject to customary adjustments. The acquisition includes approximately 176,000 net acres in the Midland Basin with estimated 2027 oil production of 35 MBo/d and over 1,200 estimated gross horizontal locations. The transaction, valued at approximately 4.0x estimated 2027 EBITDA, is expected to close on December 21, 2026, and is immediately accretive to cash flow per share, free cash flow per share and NAV per share.

items.title: Cheniere Energy Partners appoints Zach Davis as President and CFO
items.summary: Zach Davis, who has served as Chief Financial Officer of Cheniere Partners GP, LLC since 2020, was appointed President and Chief Financial Officer of the General Partner effective November 16, 2026. Davis, 42, also holds the same roles at Cheniere Energy, Inc. and has over 20 years of experience in energy and infrastructure finance. Jack Fusco continues as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

items.title: Keurig Dr Pepper completes $2.25B share offering to reduce debt
items.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper completed an underwritten public offering on November 16, 2026, selling 66.7 million shares at $34.50 per share and raising approximately $2.25 billion in net proceeds after underwriting discounts. The company intends to use the proceeds to repay or repurchase approximately $2.0 billion of outstanding debt, including borrowings under its delayed draw term loan, commercial paper notes and senior unsecured notes, as part of its capital allocation strategy ahead of its planned separation into two independent publicly traded companies in early 2027.

items.title: American Tower prices €1.2 billion senior notes offering
items.summary: American Tower Corporation priced a registered public offering of €600 million senior unsecured notes due 2031 at 4.200% per annum and €600 million due 2034 at 4.500% per annum on November 16, 2026. Net proceeds are expected to be €1,191.3 million (approximately $1,317.0 million) after deducting underwriting discounts and estimated offering expenses, with the company intending to use the proceeds for general corporate purposes, including refinancing upcoming euro maturities.

items.title: MetLife declares fourth quarter 2026 preferred stock dividends
items.summary: MetLife declared quarterly dividends on three series of preferred stock: $0.32584066 per share on Series A floating rate stock, $0.3515625 per depositary share on Series E 5.625% stock, and $0.296875 per depositary share on Series F 4.75% stock. The dividends are payable December 15, 2026, to shareholders of record as of November 30, 2026.

items.title: Booking Holdings issues €3.55B in senior notes across four tranches
items.summary: Booking Holdings Inc. executed four Officers' Certificates on November 13, 2026 to issue €1.25B of 3.950% Senior Notes due 2029, €800M of 4.375% Senior Notes due 2032, €750M of 4.750% Senior Notes due 2035, and €750M of 5.000% Senior Notes due 2038. The notes are senior unsecured obligations with interest payable annually beginning November 13, 2027, and the company has redemption rights under specified conditions.

items.title: Apollo Global Management issues $600 million in junior subordinated notes
items.summary: Apollo Global Management issued $600 million aggregate principal amount of 7.550% Fixed-Rate Resettable Junior Subordinated Notes due 2056 on November 13, 2026. The notes will bear a fixed rate of 7.550% until December 15, 2036, then reset to the Five-Year U.S. Treasury Rate plus 2.672%. The company intends to use net proceeds for general corporate purposes, including to fund a previously announced investment in Mubadala Capital Asset Management.

items.title: Qualcomm issues $3.75B in senior unsecured notes across five tranches
items.summary: Qualcomm Incorporated executed an Officers' Certificate on November 12, 2026 to issue $3.75B in aggregate principal amount of senior unsecured notes in a registered public offering. The notes comprise five series maturing between 2028 and 2036 with interest rates ranging from 5.000% to 5.800% per year, payable semiannually beginning May 20, 2027.

items.title: Emerson Electric completes €750 million offering of 4% notes due 2032
items.summary: Emerson Electric Co. completed a public offering of €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.000% Notes due 2032 on November 13, 2026. The notes are senior unsecured obligations that will rank equally with the company's existing and future unsecured and unsubordinated debt. Interest is payable annually on November 13, beginning November 13, 2027, and the notes mature on November 13, 2032.

items.title: TKO Group Holdings issues $1.0 billion of senior secured notes due 2031
items.summary: TKO Worldwide Holdings, an indirect subsidiary of TKO Group Holdings, issued $1.0 billion aggregate principal amount of 6.500% Senior Secured Notes due November 15, 2031, on November 13, 2026. The notes are guaranteed by TKO Guarantor LLC and wholly-owned domestic restricted subsidiaries, secured by a first priority lien on collateral securing existing senior secured credit facilities, with interest payable semiannually. TKO intends to use net proceeds for general corporate purposes, which may include distributions to fund share repurchases.
